length.rule: LL when CTL/LL flag is LL or LENGTH >= 3.5; CTL only when flag is CTL and LENGTH < 3.5

stock_ageing.measured_at: month end of the as-of date

receivables.scope: customers whose OEM resolves to TVS

tvs_proxy_customer_names: MEGH STEELS PRIVATE LIMITED TVS A

rfd_reconciliation.compare: MT to MT: SAP holds 4731 in kilograms and repeats KG in NOS, so a piece-for-piece comparison against RFD Qty. is kilograms against units
rfd_reconciliation.rfd_weight_column: WEIGHT (MT); RFD Qty. is pieces and is quoted in the comment only
rfd_reconciliation.backed_when: RFD weight for the material is at least what SAP holds, within 10 kg
rfd_reconciliation.shared_rfd_line: split between the SAP codes it names in proportion to what SAP holds
rfd_reconciliation.write_off: the sum of the per-material gaps, not whole unbacked lines

str_plan.grain: Bucket (8406 cuts to order, so cover is held at bucket level and one STR line serves any plan customer)
str_plan.requirement: max(0, target_days x schedule MT / days in month - cover)
str_plan.cover: stock at 8406 earmarked to the plan customers + tonnage in transit to 8406
str_plan.source_pool: finished goods at the source plants plus WIP mother tubes, long lengths offered before cut lengths and finished goods before WIP

wip_to_fg.rule: an STR needs a finished-goods code, so a mother tube is offered under the FERT code whose zmat description matches its own with PTM- swapped for TUB-
wip_to_fg.tie_break: prefer a code extended to the despatching plant, then one whose governed bucket matches, then the lowest code

order_book.source: sales-planning consolidation, one sheet per despatching origin
order_book.pooled_to: governed bucket for the long-length tracker, VSM SKU key for Megh Steel
notes: hk_str states no material number, so its code is recovered from the description.
The three quantity columns report different stages of the same commitment and are never interchanged.
hk_str states no age, only the date the STR was raised; the age is derived from it.
Every order line reaching no tracker row is listed individually on the missing-mappings tab.
A line marked c in the remarks column is not live demand and pools into neither tracker; it is still listed on the missing-mappings tab so the book reconciles.

code_recovery.supplement: a material-mapping extract is merged into zmat.xlsx by scripts/merge_material_mapping.py, never read as a second source
code_recovery.ambiguous: a description extended under several codes recovers none; the candidates are quoted

megh_length_bucketing.source: the vsm stock plan's own key, length and per-plant material-code columns
megh_length_bucketing.why: Megh Steel buys length-specific sizes, and the plan names codes Bucketting does not carry

pricing.key: contract Key = dimension1-dimension2-thickness, matching the first three parts of a governed Bucket; the second dimension is empty for a round tube
pricing.rule: price per m = base price per m for the quarter + sum(rate INR/tonne x contract kg/m / 1000); LL quoted per metre, CTL per piece at its own length
pricing.high_strength: ERW 2 and HST grades price off the contract's -HST variant where the size has one; the contract heads that band 'High strength / HST 370/ERW2'

value_add_sources.Fin cut: Schedule July FC/NFC is FC or FIN CUT
value_add_sources.Angle cut: Schedule July Angle Cut column is AG
value_add_sources.Annealing: Bucketting Annealed is AN, or the material description carries an -AN- segment

code_repository.scope: customers whose OEM resolves to TVS, plus the Megh Steel conversion codes
code_repository.grain: bill-to code x ship-to code x despatch plant x material code
code_repository.purpose: a price change must be raised against every combination that has actually been billed, and one SKU is often billed under several material codes

sales_trend.note: the other sheets in those workbooks are working copies whose rows are all in Sheet1; reading them double counts

segments.agent: customer code 943209, Megh Steel converting for TVS

sales_trend.value_add_source: Schedule July, matched on material code
sales_trend.month_source: one month from one source; the daily dump wins, archives fill the rest

reference_dumps.holds: every file the owner shared, under the canonical input filenames
reference_dumps.reason: the GitHub repository is private, the Vercel deployment is not

megh_bop.source: list supplied by the owner; dimensions, nominal length, pieces and plant
megh_bop.match: bucket dim1-dim2-thickness exact, then nearest length, one SKU per listed line
megh_bop.unmatched: added to the Megh tab as its own line item, plan columns zero

schedule.resolved_from: the as-of month, e.g. Schedule August
schedule.row_bound: every row naming a Helper Customer, not a fixed count

dumps_layout.current_month: dumps/ holds the latest of every file for the month being published
dumps_layout.archive: dumps/YYYY-MM/ holds the month's final set, moved there when the month closes
stays_at_top_level: sales_<mon>.xlsx — still read as a trend source
sales_q4.xlsx, sales_q1.xlsx — still read as trend sources

sheets.jsr: Y/N flag on Sign Off; the line's Bal to Desp falls whole to one side
sheets.hosur: SIGN OFF is the signed MT; the rest of Order Qty in MT is unsigned
sheets.khopoli: Sign Off and Non Sign Off are both stated; its Order Qty in MT is pieces

order_signoff.unused: jsr's Sign Off Qty — exceeds Bal to Desp on 9 of 27 rows, so it measures something else
